title: Signal Chat
summary: A ChatGPT-style streaming SSR signal lab with independent data channels, deferred catch-up, failure recovery, and reproducible captures.

journeys.title: Replay an early Send command with its native composer value after client code arrives
Keep usable content during quiet refresh and show pending output during reset
Export distinct visible revisions and producer terminals for superseded generations
Stream the full escaped Unicode prompt and answer in a mobile viewport
Deliver the public shell and first HTML snapshots independently
Preserve early native input and adopt deferred nodes without duplicate initial loading
Display complete Unicode results through eager independent regions
Recover failures before and after a first value and empty completion
Fence superseded responses and close stopped producers before resuming

faultScenarios.description: The answer fails before its first value while history and tools continue independently.
The answer fails after a partial cumulative value; the last accepted text remains inspectable and retry recovers.
The answer producer completes without yielding, exercising the resource error contract.
Composed shell hydration can be delayed up to five seconds while independent widgets activate, the server streams, and native input is captured.
Submitting another prompt or stopping an active generation cancels obsolete work before it can publish.
